translations.web: So man is brought low, mankind is humbled, and the eyes of the arrogant ones are humbled;
translations.bsb: So mankind will be brought low, and each man humbled; the arrogant will lower their eyes.
translations.kjv: And the mean man shall be brought down, and the mighty man shall be humbled, and the eyes of the lofty shall be humbled:
translations.asv: And the mean man is bowed down, and the great man is humbled, and the eyes of the lofty are humbled:
